title: friendsframe
summary: The social surface follows current Benilla's three-tab Friends/Who/Guild structure (no invented Raid tab). FriendsFrameUiLaw owns the 384x512 window seat, scroll icon, exact Friends/Ignore/Who row and faux-scroll geometry, action rectangles, dynamic Who column widths, and the Zone/Guild/Race selector. GameLoop.Social implements the Friends/Ignore inset toggle, asynchronous contact gates, add/remove/ignore/invite and Send Message flows, independently scrolled lists, Who search/results, and the authored dropdown capsule/menu. Authored fixed-size Who and Guild roster FontStrings now use the shared build-5875 overflow law, so long names/zones/classes/ranks/notes/status values back off to the exact ASCII-three-dot marker inside their seats; auto-height Friends text is deliberately unchanged. GuildFrameUiLaw and GameLoop.Guild provide the matching Guild shell, 298x16 roster rows, faux scrollbar, Show Offline ordered-prefix behavior, player/status column toggle, MotD text, totals, and exact bottom action seats. Guild headers drive the reference eight-key remembered-direction sort stack; the lazy guild query supplies the guild-name title and real rank names, and presence retains the DND-before-AFK status tag. ADD_FRIEND, ADD_IGNORE and ADD_GUILDMEMBER occupy the shared two-slot StaticPopup seat with law-owned edit geometry and exact twelve-letter caps. Guild Information is the exact 297x298 rule-positioned satellite, with its 500-letter board, rank-right gate, placeholder, backdrops, CMSG_GUILD_INFO_TEXT, and roster refresh. The rule-positioned 212px member-detail card toggles from roster rows, changes height with officer-note visibility, gates and sends promote/demote/remove/group-invite actions, and edits both 31-letter notes through the shared 420px wide StaticPopup shape. Guild Control occupies its exact 297x298 satellite seat with the four-piece MacroPopup art, 13-option staged rights buffer, leader gate, rank selector/name editor, inverted checkbox sounds, 15-letter Add Rank popup, bottom-rank removal law, and exact CMSG_GUILD_RANK/ADD_RANK/DEL_RANK bodies. The guild notification family decodes promotion/demotion/membership/leader/presence/MotD events, command results, invitations, declines and /ginfo; composes the reference system lines, suppresses ignored presence, re-asks on exact stale edges, and hosts GUILD_INVITE in the shared rule-sized 60-second StaticPopup with exact empty accept/decline wires.

openItems.text: No Send Message button (BenillaFriendsFrameSendMessageButton) - whispering a selected friend requires typing /w manually
openItems.resolution: The exact 131x21 Send Message button at (214,384) opens the chat edit box prefilled `/w <selected name> ` and, like current Benilla, is enabled only for a selected online friend (also waiting for MSUI's asynchronous name resolution).

openItems.text: Live-verify ADD_FRIEND/ADD_IGNORE visual placement, focus, twelve-letter cap, Enter/Accept/Cancel/Escape wire cardinality, and stacking with a second StaticPopup.

Live-verify Friends, Ignore, Who, and Guild visual placement at empty, partial, and overflowing row counts; exercise wheel scrolling, Who variable dropdown sorting, Show Offline filtering, roster view toggle, and selection retention.

Guild Control remains inert. Guild Information, Add Member, and the selected-member detail/promote/demote/remove/note surfaces are implemented with rule-owned geometry and exact wire paths. Implement the rank-control satellite as a rule-owned GuildFrame dialog rather than an ad-hoc ImGui modal.
openItems.resolution: Guild Information, member detail and Guild Control now use authored law-owned satellite seats. Control stages a selected rank's 13 mapped rights and 15-letter name, saves one exact CMSG_GUILD_RANK, adds through ADD_GUILDRANK, removes only an empty sixth-or-lower bottom rank, and keeps the three satellites mutually exclusive.

openItems.text: Guild event/command packets update telemetry and MOTD only; the reference's promotion/demotion/join/leave/remove/leader/presence/invite/decline/info system lines, ignored-member suppression, invite popup, and stale-roster refresh edges remain absent.
openItems.resolution: GuildFramePacketLaw now owns the exact event/command/invite/decline/info decoders and reference-composed lines. Runtime applies the MotD/rank-name cache edges, suppresses ignored sign-on/off lines, refreshes stale rosters on the reference event/result bands, wires /ginfo, and shows GUILD_INVITE in the shared 320px law-sized StaticPopup for 60 seconds with exactly one CMSG_GUILD_ACCEPT or CMSG_GUILD_DECLINE action.

openItems.text: Live-verify the guild-name and rank-name cache fill, all eight header sorts and remembered directions, Show Offline ordered prefix, DND/AFK status display, selection retention and crowded column widths.

Live-verify Guild Information's authored satellite position, scroll/caret following, editable and read-only rank-right states, empty-board placeholder, 500-letter cap, disabled Save, close controls, and one CMSG_GUILD_INFO_TEXT followed by one roster refresh.

Live-verify same-row toggle and cross-row repaint of GuildMemberDetailFrame, its 195/255 officer-note heights, permission-gated arrows/remove/note panes, group invite gating, 31-letter wide note dialogs, and remove confirmation wire cardinality.

Live-verify Guild Control's leader-only gate, exact satellite placement and MacroPopup art, rank dropdown switching/discard, 13 checkbox positions/mapping/inverted sounds, dirty Accept state, 15-letter Add Rank popup, and last-rank empty-member removal gate.

Live-verify guild promotion/demotion/join/leave/remove/leader/presence/MotD lines, ignored presence suppression, stale-roster request cardinality, /ginfo date/count lines, invite/decline notices, and GUILD_INVITE placement/stacking/60-second timeout/accept/decline cardinality while alive and dead.
